svg.text: BC-250 TOP side - TPMS1 header, pin 9 ('3V' = PC is on)
Next to the Ethernet jack and the corner mounting hole 'H9'. A Dupont jumper wire can push straight onto pin 9.
Render based on reference photos (tfabris/BC-250). If pin 9 reads 3.3 V while the PC is OFF, it is the wrong pin (pin 15 is always 3.3 V).
